premises.text: Job seekers are reduced to resumes in a pile and struggle to stand out
premises.evidence_span: when we go look for a job, we get reduced to this. Just another resume and a pile of paper

premises.text: Company-sponsored low-stakes competitions let tech professionals compete and earn rankings
premises.evidence_span: Competitions are sponsored by companies. They are low stakes

premises.text: Skills scoring and certifications across many topics differentiate professionals on the platform
premises.evidence_span: Skills is the heart of Guild. This is what truly differentiates us

premises.text: Job recommendations, application feedback, and ranking tell professionals their interview chances and how to improve
premises.evidence_span: it is recommending jobs that I should be applying for, where I have a good chance of getting an interview

premises.text: Employers sponsor competitions and browse ranked participants to invite passive candidates directly
premises.evidence_span: I can go down and flip through every single person who participated, and they are ranked

premises.text: Guild is free for professionals and monetizes by charging employers with no agencies
premises.evidence_span: Guild is free for professionals. We monetize by charging employers

value.text: Technology professionals compete, connect, and advance careers while employers find best people

secondary_value.text: Employers target and find the best people without third-party agencies
